In view of the importance of future urban subway shield tunnel management and maintenance, this paper fully draws on the existing railway tunnel and highway tunnel management technology methods, in-depth analysis of the characteristics of subway shield tunnel, combined with tunnel detection engineering experience, the subway shield tunnel structure quality safety evaluation system analysis, in an attempt to establish the early operation of subway tunnel related technical standards Give some useful insights.
